title: Campaign of Tlemcen (1551)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Campaign of Tlemcen (1551)", at revision 1376495158, opens: "The Campaign of Tlemcen (1551) was a military operation led by the Regency of Algiers under Hasan Pasha and his ally Abdelaziz, following the capture of Tlemcen by the Saadi Sultanate in June 1550. The Saadian forces were defeated at the Abou Azoun river and the Moroccan garrison in Tlemcen was massacred." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q28495579, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1551 Algerian expedition". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
